pages.title: A meal for the work ahead
text: Fuller than [road fare](road_fare) and cooked from the March's wild catch: each meal fills you well and lends one plain gift for the task in front of you. None fills more than the best [tribe dish](tribe_dishes), and none carries a boon.
- **Drift-bell Dumplings**: Drift Jelly, Steppe Grain, an egg. Two to a pot, 5 hunger and **Slow Falling for 30 seconds**: eat before a drop.
- **Delver's Pottage**: a brown and a red mushroom, a potato, Fen Rice, a bowl. 7 hunger and **Haste for 90 seconds**, a miner's bowl.
- **Fen-caller's Chowder**: any raw fish (Raw Glimmerfin or Raw Silt Eel), Fen Rice, kelp, a potato, a bowl. 8 hunger and **Water Breathing for 90 seconds**.

pages.title: A meal for the work ahead, continued
text: - **Reed-wrapped Eel**: Raw Silt Eel, Spirit Reed, March Leaf. 7 hunger and **Night Vision for 120 seconds**, for dark water and deep caves.
- **Ember-roast Squash**: a pumpkin, Emberroot, Steppe Grain. Two to a pot, 6 hunger and **Strength for 30 seconds**.
- **Long-hunt Stew**: Roast Game, a potato, a carrot, Emberroot, a bowl. 9 hunger, the fullest camp fare, and **Absorption for 60 seconds**: eat it before a hard night.
- **Bloomsong Custard**: Echo Bloom, an egg, sugar, honeycomb, a bowl. 6 hunger and **Regeneration for 15 seconds**, to mend on the move.
Bowls come back when you eat. Packs can change how long each gift lasts in the config.
